issues.explanation: Chapter 96 says 孔明’s gain of 姜维 was a ‘capture’ (擒得姜维), but Chapter 95 presents 姜维 as a Shu commander who helps lead the rear-guard and returns to Han中. The source wording means obtaining/recruiting 姜维, not necessarily capturing him.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “擒得姜维” with “得到姜维” or “招降姜维” to preserve his established Shu identity and timeline.
